themes.disagreements: Effect modification signals are present but moderate (support fractions ~0.4), suggesting their role as confounders may be equally prominent.
themes.interpretation: Measurements regarding the presence and size of adrenal nodules show consistent evidence of influence on treatment assignment, outcome prognosis, and effect modification.
themes.name: Adrenal-related Indicators

themes.disagreements: Age is an overwhelming confounder, whereas history of AKI shows only a weak signal for effect modification and minimal prognostic value.
themes.interpretation: Core patient characteristics, most notably age, exhibit powerful evidence as confounders affecting both treatment and outcome.
themes.name: Patient Demographics and Comorbidities

themes.disagreements: ALC has negligible treatment signal but strong effect modification evidence; ANC is strongly prognostic and moderately linked to treatment.
themes.interpretation: Absolute counts of lymphocytes and neutrophils show divergence, with lymphocytes acting as potential effect modifiers and neutrophils as confounders.
themes.name: Hematological Parameters

themes.disagreements: Acetaminophen administration is primarily a confounder, while adjuvant chemotherapy is a strong candidate for effect modification.
themes.interpretation: Previous administration of medications or chemotherapy shows a split between simple confounding and heterogeneous treatment effects.
themes.name: Prior Therapeutic Interventions

themes.disagreements: Airway involvement is a moderate confounder/modifier; actionable molecular alterations provide very weak signals across all roles.
themes.interpretation: Indicators of disease location and genetic actionability show varied importance, with airway involvement being more prominent than molecular markers.
themes.name: Anatomic and Molecular Markers
